name: Prompt Craft
lede: Four missions, about ten minutes each. Level 1 got you a good first answer. This level gets you control: your voice, your format, your fixes, and a kit you can reuse.
description: Level 2 of an interactive AI course for marketers: match your brand voice, teach with examples, fix near misses, and build a reusable prompt kit.

missions.name: Write Like You
missions.hook: “Friendly and professional” describes ten thousand brands. Find the traits that make one voice recognizable, then hand them to the AI on a card.
missions.objective: Pull the traits out of a real brand voice and turn them into a voice card the AI can follow.

missions.name: Show, Don’t Tell
missions.hook: One good example beats a paragraph of adjectives. Add examples, change the format, and watch the same request come back different.
missions.objective: Use examples and a clear output format to get the result you want on the first try.

missions.name: Fix the Miss
missions.hook: The first draft is rarely the one you send. Three weak drafts, three follow-ups to choose from. Pick the one that actually moves things.
missions.objective: Choose the follow-up that fixes a weak draft, and split a big task into three steps.

missions.name: Build Your Kit
missions.hook: Time to keep something. Pick a type, fill a few boxes, and get a template you can copy, reuse, and change one placeholder at a time.
missions.objective: Leave with reusable prompt templates for an ad, an email, and a landing page section.

recap: A voice card is a few followable traits plus one real sample line.
Examples set the style. A format line sets the shape.
Follow up with a specific change, or break big jobs into a chain.
You built reusable templates with placeholders for ads, emails, and pages.
next: Next up: Level 3, Marketing Machine. Put AI to work on research, content, ad tests, and reports.
